newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Mini-skirted Zimbabwean bride barred from court.
newsitem.headline: Mini-skirted Zimbabwean bride barred from court.

text.p: Security officers barred a bride from wedding at a Zimbabwe civil court, saying her skirt was "too short" and not decent enough as required by court rules.
The groom was arrested and fined for arguing with the security and police officers over the issue and trying to force his way into the building on Wednesday, a local newspaper reported.
